title: clauder-workbench fan-out contract
description: Contract consumed by clauder-workbench fanout-plan / fanout-run / merge-gate. One worker per child R process; each emits a state/manifest/validation triple under artifacts.output_root.

task_key.description: Stable task identity used for inflight registration and evidence linkage.

max_parallel.description: Requested concurrency ceiling (starting ceiling with auto-scale), unless overridden on the CLI. Every new worker still requires byte, commit, thread and output-volume admission.

session_name.description: RStudio session for this batch's resource probe and workers. The CLI session selection takes precedence; an unbound or unknown worker host cannot admit workers.

requires_native_smoke.description: When true, fanout-plan/run/poll/merge-gate require fresh parent evidence from clauder-workbench native-smoke complete before proceeding.

max_age_min.description: Maximum age, in minutes, of accepted native-smoke parent evidence.

require_resource_gate.description: Require matching resource_gate increase_by_1 parent evidence during strict completion-check.

resource_gate_max_age_min.description: Maximum age of accepted resource-gate parent evidence. Defaults to 120 minutes.

output_root.description: Output directory readable by the Python file poller. Relative artifact paths resolve against this (relative output_root resolves against the contract file's directory). For another worker host, map these same durable outputs locally and declare resource_gate.worker_output_root on that host.

max_age_h.description: merge-gate rejects worker outputs older than this many hours (freshness guard).

resource_gate.description: Worker-host byte admission. JSON numbers must be finite; booleans are not budgets. Reservations cover running workers in this batch only, without a host-wide or cross-queue lease.

worker_mem_gib.description: Physical memory reservation per worker in GiB (2^30 bytes).

worker_commit_gib.description: Commit headroom reservation per worker in GiB. Unknown commit headroom holds admission.

worker_processors.description: Logical processor/thread budget reserved for each worker.

worker_output_gib.description: Output-volume space reserved for each worker in GiB.

reserve_mem_gib.description: Physical memory retained outside this batch's worker reservations, in GiB.

reserve_commit_gib.description: Commit headroom retained outside this batch's worker reservations, in GiB.

reserve_processors.description: Logical processors retained outside this batch's worker reservations.

reserve_output_gib.description: Free space retained on the worker's actual output volume, in GiB.

sample_max_age_sec.description: Maximum age of a bound worker-host resource sample; stale samples hold admission.

worker_output_root.description: Absolute output directory on the actual R worker host. Required when the Python poller reads the outputs through a different host/path; it selects the volume sampled by R. Without it, artifacts.output_root is passed unchanged for resolution by R, never resolved on the Python host for admission.

memory_threshold.description: Legacy diagnostic value only. Memory percentage does not gate fanout plan/run admission.

memory_scale_up_percent.description: Legacy diagnostic value only; does not gate fanout admission.

memory_hold_percent.description: Legacy diagnostic value only; does not gate fanout admission.

cpu_scale_up_percent.description: Legacy diagnostic value only; fanout enforces the logical processor/thread budget instead of a CPU usage percentage.

cpu_hold_percent.description: Legacy diagnostic value only; fanout enforces the logical processor/thread budget instead of a CPU usage percentage.

min_disk_free_gb_scale_up.description: Optional additional output-volume free-space hold, in GiB despite the legacy gb name; uses worker-host bytes.

min_disk_free_gb_hold.description: Optional additional output-volume free-space hold, in GiB despite the legacy gb name; uses worker-host bytes.

require_soak_monitor.description: Require fresh matching soak_monitor PASS evidence during strict completion-check.

soak_monitor_max_age_min.description: Maximum age of accepted soak_monitor parent evidence.

monitor.description: Long-soak resource, heartbeat, recovery, and safety policy.

code_file.description: Path to the R worker file. Either code_file or code is required.

code.description: Inline R code. Either code_file or code is required.

session.description: Legacy session assertion; must match the effective batch session_name. A mismatch holds admission rather than routing this worker to a different RStudio session.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the worker. NEVER place credentials here; use the environment at run time.

expected_state.description: state_<id>.json path (relative to output_root). status=='complete' is the done signal.
